sections.heading: Why Busaty
sections.body: One platform, three tailored experiences that simplify operations and enhance safety.

items.title: Reliable live tracking
items.body: See bus location and estimated arrival times in real time.

items.title: Smart notifications
items.body: Departure/arrival alerts and urgent change notices.

items.title: School control
items.body: Manage students, trips, and staff from a single dashboard.

items.title: Data protection
items.body: Encryption in transit/at rest and role-based access.

items.title: Responsive support
items.body: Quick help via email or WhatsApp.

sections.heading: Experiences for every role
sections.body: Pick the app that matches your role and launch in minutes.

items.title: Parent App
items.body: Real-time trip tracking, arrival/departure alerts, and child profile/address management.

items.title: Attendant/Driver App
items.body: Record check-in/out, access addresses on the map, and send instant updates to guardians.

items.title: School App
items.body: Add students, assign them to buses and attendants, and monitor fleet KPIs in real time.

sections.heading: Security & privacy
sections.body: We protect school transport data with enterprise safeguards.

items.body: Encryption in transit and at rest.
Clear view of collected data and user rights.

sections.heading: Support & contact
sections.body: Email: support@busaty.org — in-page contact form — floating WhatsApp button (if enabled).

appDetails.heading: App tutorials and downloads
appDetails.intro: Pick the right Busaty experience, watch the quick walkthrough, then grab the build for your device.

parent.title: Busaty Parent App
parent.description: Give families peace of mind with live bus tracking, instant alerts, and clear trip updates.
features: Track the bus live on the map and view current location.
Receive instant notifications for departures, arrivals, or route changes.
Manage each student profile and keep contact preferences updated.
Reach out to the school or supervisor whenever support is needed.

supervisor.title: Busaty Supervisor & Driver App
supervisor.description: Equip supervisors and drivers with the tools to run routes smoothly and notify guardians instantly.
features: Access complete student manifests with addresses and map locations.
Confirm boarding, manage absences, and keep rosters accurate.
Send real-time alerts to guardians about trip status and updates.
Monitor route progress and adjust schedules on the go.

school.title: Busaty School App
school.description: A powerful app for schools to orchestrate fleets, assign students, and analyse trip performance.
features: Add students with full contact details and map-based pickup points.
Assign buses, manage routes, and monitor journeys live.
Generate attendance and punctuality insights to improve operations.
Coordinate quickly with supervisors and broadcast updates to families.
